Müşterinin doğrudan satıştan gelen standart planlı fiziksel ürün iadesi için uygulanacak politika, siparişin teslim tarihine bakılmaksızın **14 takvim günlük** olan yeni 2026 standard iade politikası kapsamındadır [s.filesystem:standard-returns-2026/Standard Returns — 2026].

Eğer müşterinin Premium planı varsa veya sipariş pazar yerinden gelmişse, doğrudan satış için geçerli olan bu standart süreye tabi değildir; bunlar kendi özel politikalarıyla yönetilir.

b.raw_candidate_output:
According to the subscription billing and cancellation policies, **no next renewal charge** will be applied if a valid cancellation request is submitted. The specific requirement for this outcome depends on whether you are canceling via an account-based policy or through direct physical product return rules; however, both relevant sections confirm that proper cancellation stops future charges while preserving access until the end of the paid period.

### Subscription-Based Cancellation
To prevent a renewal charge under Negativex's standard subscription plans:
*   The cancellation request must be submitted **at least 48 hours before** the upcoming renewal date [s.filesystem:support-playbook/Support Operations Playbook/19. Recovery after an incident].
    *Note: This requirement is explicitly stated in two separate sections, confirming its consistency across policy documents.* [s.filesystem:subscription-billing/Abonelik ve Faturalandırma İşletim Politikası]
*   The cancellation **does not shorten** the prepaid period; access continues until the end of the current billing cycle. [s.filesystem:support-playbook/Support Operations Playbook/19. Recovery after an incident]

### Physical Product Return (Standard Plan Only)
If you are a Standard-plan customer returning physical goods:
*   A refund may be requested within **14 calendar days** of delivery for unused items. However, this policy specifically addresses refunds based on return eligibility rather than automatic cancellation prevention. [s.filesystem:standard-returns-2026/Standard Returns — 2026]

In summary, to avoid a next renewal charge under your subscription agreement, you must submit an account-based cancellation request **48 hours before the scheduled renewal**.
